searchText: MSRP $36,152. 2026 Forest River Aurora 18BHSX is approximately 23' 1' in length with 1 slide. Features Outside Kitchen Tankless Water Heater Tongue and Groove Floor Solar Prep GE Kitchen Suite & Appliance Package More About This RV This RV features the solid entry steps, front radius lights, multi-color power awning with remote, 600W universal solar prep w/ installed roof panel port, siphon 360 Roof vent, JBL head unit with bluetooth, HDMI & USB, multizone JBL premium interior & exterior speaker, smooth metal radius front, magnetic baggage door latches and LCI ladder prep. Additional package on this RV is the Aurora Comfort and Construction package that includes screwed cabinet construction, 5/8' tongue and groove floor, friction hinge, entry door, ABS tub/shower surround, black tank flush, 12V power vent fan in bathroom, LED interior lights, Norco electromagnetic and powder coated frame, back up camera prep & battery disconnect. This Aurora includes the GE Kitchen Suite and appliance package which includes the upgraded 13.5K GE AC with heat pump, GE 60K BTU tankless water heater, 12V 10 Cu. FT. GE refrigerator, stainless GE Microwave, Stainless GE range with range vent & drop edge thermofoil countertops and much more.
